cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.section1Content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device by websites that you visit. They are widely used in order to make websites work, or work more efficiently, as well as to provide information to the owners of the site.
cookiePolicy.section2Content: We use cookies for a variety of reasons detailed below:
cookiePolicy.essentialContent: These are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems.
cookiePolicy.performanceContent: These allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site.
cookiePolicy.functionalContent: These enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization.
cookiePolicy.section3Content: You can prevent the setting of cookies by adjusting the settings on your browser. Be aware that disabling cookies will affect the functionality of this and many other websites.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.section1Content: PayoffLab ("we," "us," or "our") operates the marketing automation platform available at PayoffLab.app. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share information from our users and their end-customers.
privacyPolicy.section2Content:
We collect the following types of information:
- Personal Account Information: When you register for PayoffLab, we collect your name, email address (via Zoho), and authentication details (processed through Supabase).
- Payment Information: All payments are processed by our online reseller Paddle.com (Merchant of Record). We do not store your full credit card or bank details on our servers.
- Marketing Data: We store information you upload for automation, such as email lists, contact names, and campaign content.
- Usage Data: We may collect IP addresses, browser types, and usage patterns to improve our service.
privacyPolicy.section3Content:
We use your information to:
- Provide, operate, and maintain PayoffLab's marketing automation features.
- Process your transactions via Paddle.
- Send system notifications (via Resend) and customer support emails (via Zoho).
- Prevent fraud and ensure compliance with Anti-Spam policies.
privacyPolicy.section4Content: We share data with trusted third-party providers only to fulfill our services: Paddle.com (Payment processing), Supabase (Backend database and user authentication), Resend (Transactional and marketing email delivery), and Zoho (Corporate email communication).
privacyPolicy.section5Title: 5. DATA OWNERSHIP AND THE GDPR / KVKK
privacyPolicy.section5Content: You are the Data Controller for any customer data (e.g., your email lists) you upload to PayoffLab. We act as the Data Processor. You represent that you have obtained all necessary consents from your customers to process their data via PayoffLab. Users in the EU (GDPR) or Turkey (KVKK) have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data.
privacyPolicy.section6Content: We use industry-standard security measures, including SSL encryption and secure database protocols provided by Supabase, to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacyPolicy.section7Content: We use cookies to manage user sessions and understand how you interact with our website to provide a better user experience.
privacyPolicy.section8Content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.
privacyPolicy.section9Content: For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at hello@PayoffLab.app or PayoffLab.app.

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.section1Content: Thank you for choosing PayoffLab (PayoffLab.app). Our goal is to ensure our marketing automation tools meet your business needs. As our payments are processed by our online reseller Paddle.com (Merchant of Record), refunds are subject to these terms and Paddle’s general conditions.
refundPolicy.section2Content: You may cancel your PayoffLab subscription at any time through your account dashboard. Upon cancellation, your account will remain active until the end of the current paid billing cycle, and you will not be charged for the following period.
refundPolicy.section3Content:
Monthly Subscriptions: We generally do not offer refunds for monthly subscriptions once the billing period has started. However, if you experience technical issues that prevent you from using the Service, please contact us within 14 days of the transaction.
Annual Subscriptions: Refunds for annual plans may be considered on a case-by-case basis if requested within 30 days of the purchase, subject to the deduction of the standard monthly rate for the period used.
refundPolicy.section4Content:
Refunds will not be granted in the following cases:
- Accounts suspended or terminated due to violations of our Terms of Service (e.g., sending SPAM, illegal content).
- Users who have significantly used the automation features (e.g., sent a large volume of emails) during the billing period.
- Issues arising from third-party services integrated with PayoffLab.
refundPolicy.section5Content: To request a refund, please email us at hello@PayoffLab.app with your transaction details and the reason for your request. Alternatively, you can contact Paddle Support directly as they are our authorized reseller.
refundPolicy.section6Content: Approved refunds will be processed via Paddle using the original payment method. Depending on your financial institution, it may take 5–10 business days for the credit to appear on your statement.
refundPolicy.section7Content: For any questions regarding our Refund Policy, please contact us at hello@PayoffLab.app or PayoffLab.app.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.section1Content: By accessing or using PayoffLab (the "Service"), a marketing automation platform operated via PayoffLab.app, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Service.
termsOfService.section2Content: PayoffLab provides marketing automation tools, including but not limited to email campaigns, lead management, and automation workflows. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue any feature of the Service at any time.
termsOfService.section3Content: Our order process is conducted by our online reseller Paddle.com. Paddle.com is the Merchant of Record for all our orders. Paddle handles all customer service inquiries and returns related to payments. By subscribing to PayoffLab, you also agree to Paddle’s Terms and Conditions.
termsOfService.section4Content: To use PayoffLab, you must create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
termsOfService.section5Content: PayoffLab strictly prohibits the use of the Service for sending unsolicited emails (SPAM). You may only send marketing communications to recipients who have given explicit consent (Opt-in). You must comply with all applicable laws, including but not limited to CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR, and KVKK. We reserve the right to suspend accounts with high bounce rates or spam complaints.
termsOfService.section6Content: Subscriptions are billed in advance on a recurring cycle (monthly or annually). You may cancel your subscription at any time through your dashboard. Access will continue until the end of the current billing period. Refund requests are handled in accordance with our Refund Policy and via Paddle’s support.
termsOfService.section7Content: You retain all rights to the data you upload to PayoffLab (e.g., email lists). Our use of your personal data and your customers' data is governed by our Privacy Policy.
termsOfService.section8Content: PayoffLab is provided "as is." To the maximum extent permitted by law, PayoffLab shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the Service.
termsOfService.section9Content: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your access to the Service immediately, without prior notice, if you breach these Terms.
termsOfService.section10Content: If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at hello@PayoffLab.app or via PayoffLab.app.

FAQ.title: Questions, answered clearly
FAQ.subtitle: FAQ
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know before you connect your workflow, invite the team, or move billing into PayoffLab.

questions.q: What is PayoffLab exactly and how does it differ from a CRM?
questions.a: While a CRM is a system of record, PayoffLab is an execution layer. It gathers leads from various channels (Google Ads, WhatsApp, Forms), scores them using AI, and manages automated follow-up sequences via Gmail and WhatsApp. It allows you to run your operations in PayoffLab without cluttering your CRM, syncing only qualified leads.

questions.q: Do you offer lead discovery or a global database?
questions.a: Currently, PayoffLab focuses on optimizing inbound lead operations. It is uniquely powerful at capturing and processing leads from Google Ads, Meta, and Web forms. Our B2B database feature is on our roadmap and will be available soon.

questions.q: How does the AI work? Will it really save my team time?
questions.a: Our AI is more than just a chatbot. It's trained on your brand voice and knowledge base to understand intent, book meetings via your calendar, and prioritize the hottest leads. This level of automation can reduce manual triage and follow-up time by up to 80%.

questions.q: Are the WhatsApp and Gmail integrations secure?
questions.a: Yes. PayoffLab utilizes WhatsApp Business API and Google OAuth protocols. Your data is end-to-end encrypted and used only for the flows you authorize. Data security is at the core of our platform.

questions.q: Which CRMs and tools do you integrate with?
questions.a: We offer native integrations with popular CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho, and Close, as well as Slack, Discord, and Google Sheets. We also support webhooks to connect with your existing stack in minutes.

questions.q: Can I really manage everything in "one single flow"?
questions.a: Absolutely. You can build the "Capture -> Score -> Sequence -> Meeting -> Sync" cycle as a single Revenue Workflow within PayoffLab. We close all the operational gaps between lead capture and pipeline visibility.
